scientific_integrity: Analytic group Fourier proof and an elementary spherical overlap argument; no independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the positive-trace Haar-hemisphere step measure on SU(2) is covered. Finite code tests corroborate but cannot replace the all-time proof. Novelty remains subject to inaccessible or unindexed specialized literature.
title: Exact all-time total variation for a hemispherical walk on \(\mathrm{SU}(2)\)
